content: उत्कण्ठते <ab>Den.</ab> <ab>Ā.</ab> .²1 To be anxious, pine or be sorry for; <ls>Ś. 4</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 54</ls>. .²2 To yearn, be eagerly desirous of (with <ab>gen.</ab> or <ab>dat.</ab>); स्वर्गाय नोत्कण्ठते <ls>V. 3</ls>, <ls n="V.">4</ls>; <ls>Mv. 6</ls>; उत्कण्ठते च युष्मत्सन्निकर्षस्य <ls>U. 6</ls>, <ls n="U.">6. 21</ls>; <ls>Māl. 4</ls>; <ls>Bk. 5. 75</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (उत्कण्ठयति) To create anxiety or longing, inspire with tender emotions; <ls>Bh. 1. 35</ls>; <ls>Ghaṭ. 5</ls>.
